tools.name: get_name

tools.name: how_to_rent
tools.description: Returns the exact steps for this agent and its human to rent a name and point its DNS, with every URL; call it once the user has picked a name.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_name, start_rent, get_rent_status · Public sink: start_rent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_name, start_rent, get_rent_status · Public sink: start_rent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_lease_terms" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
